name: Bini Aumaia
description: A 98-hectare farm less than a kilometre from the centre of Es Mercadal, set on a hillside, with the Menorcan house restored on a single floor. It is a working operation: an organic kitchen garden, free-range hens and cattle, and guests are welcome to join the day's work, starting with collecting the eggs.

practicalInfo.acceso: Finca Bini Aumaia, 07740 Es Mercadal. About 850 metres from the village centre.
practicalInfo.horario: The season is not published; confirm 2026 dates on the official site.
practicalInfo.servicios: A working farm with an organic garden, hens and cattle. Restored single-storey Menorcan house.
